query: What data governance and ethics protocols (IRB, consent, anonymization, NDA rules, partner reputational safeguards) are required for internal communications and field pilots?

response.query: What data governance and ethics protocols (IRB, consent, anonymization, NDA rules, partner reputational safeguards) are required for internal communications and field pilots?
response.answer: For internal communications and field pilots, ensure compliance with IRB protocols, obtain informed consent, and anonymize data. NDA rules and partner reputation safeguards are also required.

results.title: HRPP Guidance Topics | Rutgers Research
results.content: A list of topics containing information and best practices to support Human Subject Research excellence. When using AI in research, whether as a supporting investigative tool or a technology with which human subjects directly interact, researchers must clearly explain in consent forms how AI will be used, what kinds of data it will access, and explicitly outline any associated risks and limitations. The Rutgers AI Consent Guide provides suggested language that can be adapted for informed consent processes or documents, ensuring clarity, transparency, and ethical rigor aligned with the latest best practices for using AI in human-subject research. **Confidential**: *There exists a documented linkage between a subject's identity and his/her response in the research, and the investigator provides assurance in the protocol and in the informed consent form that the identity of any individual subject will not be revealed in any report of the study.*  Confidential means that the investigator can (or could) identify individuals who participated in a study, perhaps through a code.

results.title: [PDF] Clinical Data Management Software for Clinical Trials - IntuitionLabs
results.content: In another example, an academic trials unit successfully transitioned from a patchwork of manual processes to 100% electronic data capture by adopting a unified CDM platform – they reported significantly reduced timelines and improved data management efficiency, which was critical during COVID-19 studies medidata.com medidata.com. Additionally, there’s demand for CDM systems that can integrate with real-world data sources to support things like hybrid trials or post-marketing studies, aligning with initiatives to link clinical research and healthcare data (e.g., via FHIR as discussed). It also means CDM systems need to support multilingual and multi-regional trials (e.g. handling different time zones, languages, and local data protection laws), something vendors are addressing ccrps.org ccrps.org.
